text: 股市资金流向图：今日沪深两市主力资金净流出838.86亿元，占比3.49%；大单资金净流出409.39亿元，占比1.7%；小单资金净流入670.88亿元，占比2.79%
text_en: Stock Market Capital Flow Chart: Today, Main Capital Net Outflow from Shanghai and Shenzhen Markets Reaches 83.886 Billion Yuan, Accounting for 3.49%; Large Order Net Outflow at 40.939 Billion Yuan, 1.7%; Small Order Net Inflow at 67.088 Billion Yuan, 2.79%
